title: BridgeLink WebAdmin plugin manifest (webadmin.json) — v3
description: Declarative UI an engine extension contributes to BridgeLink WebAdmin. Editor/CI tooling artifact for the manifest contract (docs/WEBADMIN-PLUGIN-CONTRACT.md); accepts manifestVersion 1, 2, and 3 (the v1 and v2 schema files stay frozen for existing $schema pointers). manifestVersion 2 reserves the contribution-kind names transmissionModes, dataTypes, connectorSections, and transformerSteps. manifestVersion 3 adds the collection field types (map, multimap, stringList, table), the variableToggle wrapper, and the section `presentation` hint. This schema does not itself version-gate those additions (a nested per-version field gate is not cleanly expressible in JSON Schema); the runtime validator enforces that they require manifestVersion 3, so a v3 collection field on a v1/v2 manifest is a validator-only rejection. The hand-rolled runtime validator (lib/runtime-plugins/manifest-validator.ts) is the authoritative enforcement point and is kept in lockstep by __tests__/unit/manifest-schema-lockstep.test.ts. This schema is intentionally NO STRICTER than that validator (so an editor never flags a manifest the runtime would load); several validator rules cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and are therefore NOT checked here: action-endpoint /extensions/<path>/ prefix, condition `field` references resolving to a declared SCALAR field key (for data types: a key of the SAME property group), MAX_FIELDS_PER_PANEL summed across a panel's sections (or a data type's property groups), cross-item uniqueness (transportName / tabKey / field key / data type name / property group / connector section name / connector section (mode, propertiesClass) pair / transformer step name / transformer step stepClass), variableToggle companion-element collisions, the rule that variableToggle is not allowed on data-type or transformer-step collection fields (the shared collectionField $def permits it everywhere), the connector-section guards (a propertiesClass owned by a compiled-in section, and an appliesTo transport the same manifest declares as a connectorPanel with the same mode), the transformer-step guard (a stepClass naming one of the seven built-in step classes), and the regex catastrophic-backtracking scan. Run the CLI validator (npm run validate:manifest) or load the extension to enforce those.

manifestVersion.description: Literal 1, 2, or 3. Any other value is skipped as an unsupported manifest version. The reserved contribution kinds require manifestVersion 2; the collection field types + variableToggle + section presentation require manifestVersion 3.

minWebAdminVersion.description: Minimum WebAdmin build version; a newer floor is skipped-with-reason on older builds.

transmissionModes.description: Declared TCP transmission modes (manifestVersion 2 only). Counts toward the same combined 8-item cap as the other contribution kinds.

dataTypes.description: Declared data types (manifestVersion 2 only). Counts toward the same combined 8-item cap as the other contribution kinds.

connectorSections.description: Sections injected into OTHER connectors' panels when applicable (manifestVersion 2 only) — the declarative ConnectorPropertiesPlugin (HTTP Auth / SSL pattern). Counts toward the same combined 8-item cap as the other contribution kinds.

transformerSteps.description: Declared filter/transformer step types (manifestVersion 2 only) — the declarative TransformerStepPlugin (Mapper / JavaScript / XSLT pattern). Counts toward the same combined 8-item cap as the other contribution kinds.

allOf.description: manifestVersion 1 is frozen: the reserved v2 contribution kinds are not allowed on a v1 manifest.

transportName.description: Connector registry key + Connector Type dropdown entry.

tabKey.description: Lowercase slug; namespaced with the extension name at registration.

presentation.description: v3. "dialog" renders the section's fields behind an Advanced button in a modal; "inline" (default) renders them in place.

name.description: Mode identifier — becomes the <pluginPointName> child and the dropdown registry key. Must match the server plugin's getPluginPointName().

propertiesClass.description: Fully-qualified name of the mode's TransmissionModeProperties subclass — written as the class attribute of <transmissionModeProperties>. Must be a real Java class of the extension (strict XStream).

defaultStartBytes.description: Default start-of-message bytes: uppercase hex, empty allowed.

defaultEndBytes.description: Default end-of-message bytes: uppercase hex, empty allowed.

startBytesValidation.description: Validation rules for the host-owned <startOfMessageBytes> element (manifestVersion 3 only). The SOM/EOM rows are rendered and serialized by the dialog, so they are not fields and their keys are reserved; a mode whose Java handler needs a rule stricter than the shared frame-mode default (valid hex, blanks allowed) declares it here. Evaluated as a text field, so the runtime validator rejects min/max.

endBytesValidation.description: Validation rules for the host-owned <endOfMessageBytes> element (manifestVersion 3 only). See startBytesValidation.

transmissionModeField.description: A transmission-mode field. Its key becomes a text child element of <transmissionModeProperties> and must be a real member of the mode's Java properties class; defaultValue is allowed (the client builds the element from scratch). The keys the shared serializer owns (pluginPointName, startOfMessageBytes, endOfMessageBytes) cannot be declared.

name.description: The data type key — the engine plugin point name, the channel XML <inboundDataType> value, the dropdown registry key, and the datatype-defaults URL segment.

isBinary.description: Binary/opaque content type (Message Trees shows an info note instead of a tree).

defaultAttachmentHandler.description: Fully-qualified name of an attachment-handler provider class, auto-selected when a source inbound type switches to this data type (the DICOM pattern).

propertyGroups.description: Property groups rendered in the Set Data Types dialog. Which groups show for a given connector context is host-derived (Java DataTypePropertiesTableModel parity); batch renders for source rows only and takes effect only when Process Batch is enabled on the connector.

dataTypeField.description: A data type property field — a scalar field (defaultValue not allowed; the "javascript" editor type additionally allowed) OR a v3 collection field (map/multimap/stringList/table) bound inside the group element. Conditions may reference SCALAR keys of the same group only (validator-enforced).

name.description: Section identifier used in error paths and status UI; unique across the array (validator-enforced).

propertiesClass.description: Fully-qualified name of the extension's ConnectorPluginProperties subclass — the section's element tag under the host connector's <pluginProperties>. Must be a real Java class of the extension (strict XStream). Classes owned by compiled-in sections (SSL, HTTP Auth) and duplicate (mode, propertiesClass) pairs are rejected by the runtime validator.

appliesTo.description: Transport names the section applies to (Java isSupported parity). A transport this manifest also declares as a connectorPanel with the same mode is rejected by the runtime validator (ambiguous double-render).

securesTransportWhen.description: When the section secures the transport (drives the HTTPS URL label / SSL-configured decoration): literal true = always while the section applies, or a Condition over this contribution's field keys.

presentation.description: v3. "dialog" renders the section's fields behind an Advanced button in a modal; "inline" (default) renders them in place.

connectorSectionField.description: A connector-section field — a scalar field (defaultValue allowed) OR a v3 collection field (map/multimap/stringList/table) bound inside the section's element under <pluginProperties>.

name.description: Step type — the registry key and the display label in the Add dropdown, the step-list table, and the detail pane. Should match the server plugin's getPluginPointName(). Unique across the array (validator-enforced).

stepClass.description: Fully-qualified name of the extension's Java Step subclass — the channel-XML element tag. Must be a real Java class of the extension (strict XStream). The seven built-in step classes and duplicate stepClass values are rejected by the runtime validator.

contexts.description: Contexts the step appears in (the Add dropdown) — the Java onlySourceConnector analog.

transformerStepField.description: A transformer-step field — a scalar field (defaultValue allowed except on "javascript"; the "javascript" editor type additionally allowed) OR a v3 collection field (map/multimap/stringList/table) serialized as a child of the step element. The keys the step registry owns (name, sequenceNumber, enabled) cannot be declared.

allOf.description: defaultValue is not allowed on "javascript" fields (no code ever travels in the manifest).

connectorField.description: A connector-panel field — a scalar field OR a v3 collection field (map/multimap/stringList/table). Its key names a direct child element of the connector's <properties> XML; defaults come from the engine defaults endpoint, so defaultValue is not allowed here.

collectionField.description: A v3 collection field. No placeholder/options/defaultValue/validation (rows have no scalar value and no compiled-in connector needs per-row validation). map/multimap use keyLabel/valueLabel; stringList uses itemLabel; table requires rowElement + columns. An optional variableToggle pairs the collection with its <xVariable>/<isUseX> scalar elements.

allOf.description: table requires rowElement + columns; the other collection types forbid them.

element.description: Row-element child tag name; a valid field key, unique within the table.

variableToggle.description: The paired "use variable" toggle. Both companion element names are explicit (the wire naming is inconsistent: isUseHeadersVariable on SMTP/WS vs useHeadersVariable on HTTP). Companion-element collisions are validator-enforced.

settingsField.description: A settings-panel field — a scalar field (defaultValue allowed) OR a v3 collection field (map/multimap/stringList/table), whose rows are stored as canonical JSON in the property value.

type.description: The allowed enum is declared per contribution kind (dataTypeField additionally allows "javascript").

allOf.description: options are required for select/radio and forbidden otherwise.
javascript fields accept only the "required" rule (a pattern would fail closed on real script lengths; min/max are number-only anyway).
min/max validation rules only on number fields.
